description: This file defines a Java interface named Auditable which provides methods for getting and setting an AuditSection, used for tracking audit information in classes implementing this interface.

classes.name: Auditable
classes.description: A Java interface for auditable entities providing methods to access audit information.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the current AuditSection associated with the entity.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the AuditSection for the entity.
